data.buildInstructions: Implement typed C1-C5 and exclusive W1-W5 contracts, source evidence and version records, schema checks, scoped reads and local artifact receipts. Persist run manifests only under approved retention policy; no business connectors. Use CASE/requestId and expectedRevision to reject concurrent old changes. Implement deterministic domain checks: First select question and frozen collection, then retrieve both supporting and contrary passages. No relevant evidence yields an explicit gap, never a fabricated recommendation. Distinguish observed quote, inference and recommendation per claim. No participant names in output; use approved aliases. Date/week comes from staff selection, never model inference. Silence is not consensus. Build future fixture harness from eval-set.json and keep synthetic versus actual evidence separate. Release uses all goldens in EV release entry and held-out staff labels; review-only stop returns work to staff. Run no provider or operational call from this design. After delivering the PDF ask exactly once: “Would you also like a visual HTML version in the same ten-stage structure as the app?” No HTML before opt-in.
